title: Contender for best play of the year?  #Theatre #TheatreReview #Counti...
transcript: If you only ever take one of my theater recommendations, I hope it's this one. Because, y'all know, I see a ton of shows like, this was my hundred and fiftieth show of the year. But of all the shows that I've seen this year, this one really stands apart as something truly special. Now, it is three and a half hours with two intermissions, which I know scares some people off. But when I tell you, it flies by. And I say this as someone with ADHD who often struggles with a lot of longer plays. I did not struggle with this one. I should also say that I am not being paid for this review. I was not invited to see the show. I paid for my ticket. I just really, really loved the show and think more people need to see it. It tells a multi generational story of a Sri Lankan family now living in Australia. And throughout the play, we learn more about this family's history and why they ultimately had to leave Sri Lanka to come to Australia. Along the way, you are not only learning about the family history, but also the history of Sri Lanka itself. And I personally found it very rewarding to be able to learn so much about a country and a culture that I'm just not that familiar with and that we don't really see on American stages all that often. I also felt as though a lot of the Events of the play mirror a lot of what we see going on in the world today. So even though it is a historical piece, it still feels really pressing. And even if you're watching this video thinking, eh, I don't really know if this play is for me, I think you should take a chance on this one, cause I really, really think it's worth your time. And it's only running through the 22nd, so you only have a week left to see it. But I promise you that this is a show that is worth rearranging your schedule for.
